verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's docs show some autonomous background behaviors (RSS campaigns auto-send on schedule, transactional webhooks firing on events, and 'Analytics AI' referencing automations) but there is no clear description of AI-native or agent-driven automation setup akin to autonomous workflows a modern AI-native user would configure. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-driven autonomous automation building (e.g., Customer Journeys with AI logic), evidence of conditional/triggered multi-step automations, and independent confirmation that these automations run reliably without manual intervention.
